column6: The labyrinth of Traujito, where the king of Rikistria,
once driven out by his people, hid himself.
Fearing the living king, Rikistria's central council
sent many mercenaries into the labyrinth.
Most mercenaries died in the labyrinth. But a nameless one
of a ruined band went in alone later and slew the king.
In the labyrinth slept two holy swords
stolen from the kingdom of Verdite.
The nameless mercenary found a holy sword here
and returned it to an envoy from Verdite.
One was sealed in the vault of Verdite,
but the other has not yet been found.
